fields.anthropic_api_key_help: Create one in the Claude Console, under API keys.
fields.base_url_help: The address that ends in /v1, for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
fields.gemini_api_key_help: Create one in Google AI Studio, under Get API key.
fields.model_help: Pick one from the list, or type the ID of any model your provider offers.
fields.openai_api_key_help: Create one on the OpenAI platform, under API keys.
fields.openai_compatible_api_key_help: Leave empty if the server needs none, like a local Ollama.
